name: Audiobookshelf
short_description: Self-hosted podcast and audiobook server for managing your spoken audio.
description: Audiobookshelf is a self-hosted podcast and audiobook server for managing and playing your audio content. It features automatic metadata fetching, progress syncing across devices, offline listening, and multiple user accounts. Dedicated mobile apps make on-the-go listening easy.
usecases: Manage and automatically download podcast subscriptions.
